title: US Executive Order 14412 (2026-06-22)
note: Regulatory deadlines are the binding constraint for federal systems and, via the FAR rule, for covered contractors. They fall 4-5 years ahead of the CRQC horizon in this pack, so ranking on CRQC alone understates urgency. crqcYear remains the physics backstop and is an INPUT, not a truth claim.
regulatoryAuthority: EO 14412 sec. 4 - key establishment by 2030-12-31, digital signatures by 2031-12-31, for HVAs and high-impact systems; FAR rule extends to covered contractors by 2030-12-31
caveats: Deadline dates are expressed as decimal years: 2031.0 means 'complete before 2031 begins', i.e. the 2030-12-31 deadline.
Sources disagree on which FAR rule falls at 180 vs 270 days. Verify against the Federal Register text before relying on the procurement dates.
CISA minimum-elements guidance for CBOMs (sec. 5(d), due ~2026-12-20) had not published when this pack was authored.
